verdict.rationale: Stripe ships a comprehensive, versioned, idempotent public REST API with API-key auth, official OpenAPI spec for SDK generation, a CLI, an official MCP server, and dedicated agent SDKs/skills for AI-native integration — directly matching the story. missing for 10: the docs.stripe.com openapi.json probe 404'd (spec lives on GitHub instead) and there's no independent hands-on report of an AI agent driving the API end-to-end.
